segments: 22 Chronography of Barhebraeus. And according to some:
his servants conspired against him when he fled to Lachish.
And the Israelites came to Jerusalem,
and breached four hundred cubits of its wall,
and took the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord and in the king's house,
and returned to Samaria.
After Amaziah, Azariah his son [ruled] fifty-two years;
he is Uzziah.
And in the twenty-fourth year of his reign, he grew arrogant and entered the temple of God to offer incense.
And when he was restrained by Azariah the priest,
and would not turn back,
he suddenly became entirely leprous.
And from then on Jotham his son judged.
Up to this point Isaiah the prophet had prophesied for twenty-four years.
And because he saw that the king grew arrogant and did not rebuke him,
prophecy was taken away from him for twenty-eight years,
until Uzziah died;
and then the righteous man prophesied again for sixty-one years.
And in the twenty-ninth year of Uzziah, Zechariah reigned over Israel for six months.
The fourth generation of Jehu's sons ended here.
And after Zechariah, Shallum reigned for one month.
And after him, Menahem [reigned] ten years.
And he attacked Tiphsah,
because they did not open its gates to him,
and destroyed it,
and ripped open its pregnant women.
And in the thirty-fourth year of Uzziah, Pul king of Babylon marched against Samaria,
and took from Menahem king of Israel a thousand talents of silver, and returned.
And in the fortieth year of Uzziah, Pekahiah reigned over Israel for ten years.
And in the forty-eighth year of Uzziah, Tiglath-pileser king of the Assyrians came up,
and took Judah and Israel captive,
and exiled {OCR?} a large portion of the people.
And that Uzziah demolished the wall of Gath and of Azotus and of Jamnia.
He also fought with the Arabs who dwell in Petra {OCR?}.
And Porphyry says
that at this time Homer and Hesiod were renowned.
After Uzziah, Jotham his son [ruled] sixteen years.
He built much of the wall of Jerusalem,
and defeated the Ammonites,
and subjected them to tribute.
After Jotham, Ahaz his son [ruled] sixteen years.
He likewise worshipped the gods of the gentiles,
and did what was evil.
